title: 四级模拟 · 社区图书馆
source: 原创模拟材料 · 非历年真题
transcript: A town library will extend its opening hours from next Monday. It will close at eight instead of six in the evening. The change follows requests from residents who finish work late. The library will also offer free reading activities for children on Saturday mornings. Volunteers will help visitors find books, but borrowing rules will remain unchanged. Question one: Why will the library extend its opening hours? Question two: What will the library offer on Saturday mornings?

options: To serve residents who finish work late.
To reduce the number of visitors.
questions.explanation: 开门时间延长是为了满足下班较晚的居民需求。
周六上午提供免费的儿童阅读活动。

title: 六级模拟 · 城市绿地研究
source: 原创模拟材料 · 非历年真题
transcript: Researchers have investigated whether small urban parks can improve people's concentration. Participants were randomly assigned either to walk through a quiet park or along a busy shopping street. Both walks lasted twenty minutes. The park group performed better on a memory task afterwards, although their walking speed was similar. The researchers caution that the study involved only a small sample and cannot prove that every green space produces the same benefit. They recommend further research across different seasons and neighbourhoods. Question one: What distinguished the two groups in the study? Question two: Why do the researchers recommend further research?

options: The speed at which they walked.
The environments through which they walked.
Their previous experience of memory tests.
questions.explanation: 两组的区别是步行环境：安静公园与繁忙商业街。

options: Walking speed could not be recorded.
questions.explanation: 样本较小，不能将结果泛化到所有绿地，因此需要进一步研究。
